identity.description: Aircall, a cloud phone and call center platform. Its Public REST API covers calls, contacts, numbers, messages (SMS/WhatsApp), webhooks, tags, teams, and analytics.
identity.identity_notes: Developer docs at developer.aircall.io describe the 'Aircall Public API' and the 'Aircall Dashboard'. The aircall.io hint matches. Redirected to developers.aircall.io for API references.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code grant only (per OAuth guide). Client ID/secret must be obtained through the Tech Partner program.
auth.token_refresh: OAuth access_token is described as permanent and does not expire; no refresh-token flow described.

access.production_restrictions: Only technology partners can publish public integrations; public MCP/app listing requires tech partner approval.

read_ops: List/retrieve users, teams, calls, conversations, numbers, contacts, tags, webhooks
write_ops: Send SMS, group and WhatsApp messages
api.limitations: Only HTTPS is valid. Webhooks require a public HTTPS endpoint with valid SSL (self-signed/HTTP not supported per support article). OAuth credentials require tech partner application. SDK found is the Aircall Everywhere UI SDK, not an API client SDK.
